set.body: Native lifecycle follow-up to server foundation bd-01M5E8JS1DZCCKCX78PMWW71V2 and lifecycle parent bd-01M3DPFH6R59EZAHADBN10VSJA. Wire File Save As and shortcut, drain the session journal queue before copying, preserve live undo and view context, reject active work and concurrent edits at handoff, release stale/failed destination candidates. Support untitled edited documents via a history-preserving creation path. Keep source files and pending edits unchanged on failures. Open Recent remains a separate preferences/menu slice.
set.title: Native Save As: stage the new writer and preserve the live project view
